name: Asamura Kengo
source:
2nd year high school student.
Hobbies: Games, Training his body, Breakdancing

Akira's friend, even though he's always treated badly by the group he doesn't seem to mind.
He seems to have a bottomless cheer that never runs out, though he sometimes cant read the mood of a situation.
A bit of a siscon...
